positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and built an interactive web application program that deals with high-volume supply chain data and generates analytical reports for manufacturing team users, using software languages such as Python, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
• Improved the backend codes to make them more computationally efficient and the front-end codes to make them more appealing and interactive for users, for the web application program.
• Built an Extracting, Transforming, and Loading (ETL) pipelines which communicates with multiple databases. This involves a large amount of SQL queries that require numerous JOINs, complex JOINs, subqueries, stored procedures, indexes, temporary tables and, query optimization.
• Enhanced the visual aspects of data analysis reports using my knowledge on data visualization and created graphical data analysis reports using Tableau and Python Matplotlib.
• Designed the relational database schema and built a database system in order to efficiently store high-volume manufacturing data and in order to efficiently share data with numerous end users, using my knowledge on relational database design theories and using my database software language skills such as MySQL and Oracle PL/SQL.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant

positions.title: Process Engineer
positions.description:
Basic & Detail Design Engineer for Pharmaceutical Plant
• Execution of Pre-concept Study and Basic Design for Pharmaceutical Plant.
• Developing Functional Design Specification (FDS) Design and Detail Design for Recombinant Protein Pharmaceutical Plant.

Process Engineer for Refinery Plant
• Developing P&IDs to ensure progress of Engineering, Procurement and Construction is on track.
• Writing technical queries and letters regarding plant design
• Pressure relief valve and breather valve sizing, considering all potential over-pressure scenarios.
 
Commissioning Engineer for Natural Gasl Liquefaction Plant
• Controlling pre-commissioning/commissioning schedule & cost.
• Facilitating scheduling program called SCMS (similar to WINPCS or ICAPS) and MS Project for effective scheduling of construction and commissioning activities.
• Writing contractual queries to clarify the contractual commissioning scope between the client and Samsung
